title: OddsDrop coupon feed
description: Versioned feed of assistant-generated paper-trading coupons. Simulation only; not betting advice.

feedVersion.description: Schema version. Apps ignore feeds with a higher version than they support.

generatedAt.description: When this file was generated, epoch milliseconds (UTC).

coupons.description: Newest last. The publisher keeps only the most recent ~50.

strategyWeights.description: Optional, reserved for future use (market / odds-range weights). Apps currently only store it.

id.description: Stable unique id. The app imports each id at most once.

legs.description: Combo coupon: at least 3 legs, each from a different match.

matchId.description: Site match id (the `id` used by detay26.asp live-score endpoint).

home.description: Optional; if absent the app splits `match` on the first " - ".

market.description: Market name exactly as the site writes it (e.g. "Maç Sonucu", "Çifte Şans", "Altı/Üstü 2,5"). Must be a market the app can settle.

marketId.description: Market id as used by degisen26.asp (turId/marketId).

selection.description: Outcome name as the site writes it ("1", "0", "2", "Alt", "Üst", "Var", "1 ve 0", ...).

odds.description: Decimal odds at generation time; the app uses these as the coupon's odds.
